personality_one_liner: A highly legible, outdoor-ready professional agricultural tool emphasizing high-contrast utility, large touch targets, and offline-first task focus.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for outdoor use; avoid dense layouts. Minimal padding of 16px to 24px around main content. Ensure extra safe-area margin at bottom for sticky CTAs.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism for this app to guarantee pure contrast and legibility under direct sunlight.
dont's: Do not use blur or frosted effects over field data, as it can reduce readability in outdoor environments.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard providing immediate environmental context and quick access to core spraying workflows.

states.error: Card showing 'Unable to load field data' with bold retry button.

screens.layout: Use a sequential architecture starting with an image-backed hero card or plain high-contrast card for the Weather & Delta T dashboard (5 stats). Below it, stack massive, highly-visible CTAs ('Start Spray Job' and 'Spray Calculator') using primary brand colors. Ensure these touch targets are oversized (minimum 56pt height). Follow with 'Upcoming Maintenance' (utilizing amber/red status badges for Due Soon/Overdue) and 'Recent Spray Records' inside crisp, white surfaceSecondary cards with 1px border. No clutter.

screens.name: Spray
screens.purpose: Live calculators for Tank Mix, Spray Rate, and Delta T with immediate visual feedback.

states.error: Inline red validation text under failed inputs

screens.layout: Input fields stacked at the top in a single column (use large 48px-56px input heights for glove accessibility). Live calculation results should sit below the inputs inside a visually distinct 'Results' card (perhaps slightly tinted brandSecondary). The Delta T calculation MUST include a disclaimer text directly below the output, clearly stating it is a measured value only. No 'safe to spray' verdicts.

screens.name: Records
screens.purpose: Comprehensive history of spray jobs and entry point for new logging.

states.empty: Illustration of a clipboard with 'No spray records logged yet', plus a primary CTA to 'Log New Record'.

screens.layout: Top section features horizontally scrolling filter chips (surfaceTertiary background, pill radius). Below, a vertical list of robust cards (surfaceSecondary). Each card displays key info: Date, Paddock, Chemical, Area. A sticky 'Log New Spray Record' FAB or full-width button sits fixed at the bottom.

screens.name: Machinery
screens.purpose: Register and health status of all farm equipment.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a tractor, 'Add your first machine'.

screens.layout: List view of machinery. Each row uses a leading tinted icon container or real image if available, machine name, and a prominent right-aligned status badge (Green/Good, Amber/Due Soon, Red/Overdue). Tapping a row opens a detailed view with service hours and history.

screens.name: More
screens.purpose: Directory of secondary tools, external links, and chemical management.
screens.layout: Simple iOS-native style settings list grouped by category ('Weather', 'Chemicals & Labels', 'Spray Application', 'Agronomy'). Chemical Register is a sub-page showing product name, APVMA number, and active ingredients.

hero_boom_sprayer.alt: Boom sprayer operating over a bright yellow agricultural field

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for extreme outdoor legibility. Use #F3F4F6 for the screen background to reduce glare, and #FFFFFF for cards, providing high contrast against the very dark #111827 text.
Implement oversized touch targets. Buttons and list items must have a minimum height of 56px to accommodate users wearing gloves or operating in a moving vehicle.
Avoid glassmorphism completely in this app. Blurs reduce readability outdoors. Use solid surfaces and 1px borders instead.
For the Delta T Calculator, strictly display the measured numeric output and a disclaimer. Do not add green/red 'Safe to spray' UI elements, as this is a legal/compliance constraint.
Maintenance status badges should strictly use the defined semantic colors: success (#15803D) for Good, warning (#B45309) for Due Soon, and error (#B91C1C) for Overdue.
Ensure all primary actions (like 'Start Spray Job') are sticky at the bottom of the screen or prominently placed in the lower third for easy one-handed access.

Always apply a dark vertical gradient scrim (transparent to at least 70% opacity) if rendering text over the hero images, though for outdoor utility apps, placing text entirely outside images on solid backgrounds is heavily preferred.
